name: ROMarr
description: Request a title and ROMarr searches your indexers through Prowlarr, hands the winner to your download client, and files the ROM into your game library where it can actually be played. If you run Radarr for films and Sonarr for TV, this is the missing one. ROMarr is not tied to one library: RomM, Gaseous and Retrom are all supported and chosen with a single setting, and a folder mode writes a plain directory tree laid out by platform, which is what Batocera, RetroPie, EmulationStation, ES-DE, EmuDeck, Pegasus, Lakka, muOS and LaunchBox all read. Releases are scored with their reasoning shown, so a wrong pick is a click to correct rather than a bug report. Unofficial; not affiliated with RomM, Gaseous or Retrom.
short_desc: The *arr for games. Finds ROMs through Prowlarr and files them into your library.
author: Move Weight Foundation
